Class AbstractPulsarAnnotationsBeanPostProcessor

java.lang.Object
org.apache.pulsar.spring.annotation.AbstractPulsarAnnotationsBeanPostProcessor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanPostProcessor, InitializingBean, ApplicationContextAware, Ordered
Direct Known Subclasses:
PulsarListenerAnnotationBeanPostProcessor, PulsarReaderAnnotationBeanPostProcessor
public class AbstractPulsarAnnotationsBeanPostProcessor extends Object implements BeanPostProcessor, ApplicationContextAware, InitializingBean, Ordered
Base class implementation for the various annotation post processors in Apache Pulsar support for Spring.
